name: Rourke & Sable Lambskin Moto Jacket
description:
A classic asymmetric-zip motorcycle jacket in black lambskin, cut close through the torso with a slight flare at the hip. The lapels are wide and lay flat. Hardware is brushed nickel — zipper pulls, snaps, the two buckles at the waist. The interior is lined in smooth cotton twill. Pre-worn leather panels at the elbows and shoulders give it the look of something that has been places, though Rourke & Sable achieves this through careful finishing rather than actual age. Four exterior pockets, one interior.

Rourke & Sable is a mid-tier leather goods manufacturer with a reputation for honest materials and clean execution. This jacket occupies that reliable space between 'too cheap to trust' and 'too expensive to justify' — the Tier 3 sweet spot. Riders, musicians, and people who own exactly one nice jacket tend to make it this one.
what_it_says: You have taste and you've spent money on something real. You're not performing anything — you just like a good leather jacket.
worn_by: anyone who saved up for it
story_hooks: Rourke & Sable sources their lambskin from a single geneware ranch in rural Wisconsin — the ranch just burned down under suspicious circumstances and the next production run is indefinitely delayed
A specific serial number range of this jacket was recalled quietly — the tannery used a chemical compound that causes skin sensitization over time — but not all units were recovered
Someone is commissioning custom modifications to these jackets: hidden interior pockets sized precisely for a specific weapon profile, added by an unlicensed tailor in the Shelf

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, body-conscious silhouette with subtle attitude. The asymmetric zip creates dynamic visual tension across the chest. Wide lapels frame the shoulders with understated authority. The slight hip flare breaks up the otherwise fitted torso, preventing it from looking purely formal. On a person, it reads as 'worked for this,' neither costume nor statement piece—just well-earned confidence.
physical_description.fit: Slim through the ribs and chest with a tailored waist; the hip flare adds maybe half an inch of give. Engineered to move with the body without excess fabric. Sleeves sit close to the arm without binding. The proportions suit most frames—not aggressively cropped, not oversized.
physical_description.primary_material: Lambskin leather—supple, lightweight, develops character with wear. Smooth cotton twill lining prevents moisture and friction against clothing.
physical_description.texture: Buttery-soft lambskin with a subtle sheen. The pre-worn panels at elbows and shoulders feature burnished, slightly roughened texture—deliberate distressing that mimics years of contact and movement. Contrast between pristine and aged sections reads as honest rather than affected.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep black leather as primary. Brushed nickel hardware—zipper pulls, snaps, waist buckles—adds cool-toned metallic accents without gloss. The cotton twill interior is warm off-white, visible at cuffs and collar.
physical_description.closures: Asymmetric primary zip (left-side bias) with brushed nickel slider. Two waist buckles for adjustment and silhouette refinement. Snap closures on pockets.
distinctive_features: Asymmetric front zip—non-standard, slightly rebellious closure
Pre-aged elbow and shoulder panels—faux-worn aesthetic achieved through finishing
Wide, flat lapels with structured pitch
Four exterior pockets (chest, hip × 2, interior breast)
Brushed nickel hardware throughout—hardware as design language, not bling
Waist buckles for fitted silhouette adjustment
Cotton twill lining—functional, visible at wrist/collar
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 artifact. Mid-range pricing signals accessibility without compromise. Rourke & Sable occupies the working professional/creative class sweet spot—people who save for one quality piece and wear it until it becomes them.
physical_description.cultural_context: The uniform of honest workers, musicians, riders, and people who respect materials. Signals competence, experience, and refusal to overspend. Wearing this jacket says: 'I have standards but no pretense.' Common in GLMZ maker spaces, salvage yards, underground music venues, delivery courier communities.
physical_description.condition_typical: Arrives looking intentionally aged at stress points, with full shine elsewhere. Over years, the pristine sections develop their own patina while the pre-worn areas darken further. Scuffs and creases accumulate naturally. The jacket rewards actual use; the manufacturing fiction dissolves into genuine wear.
